about: Attention of GPT-2 small on three short sentences written for this primer, computed by make_attention.py.

heads.name: previous token
heads.note: Almost all of its weight goes to the token just before.

heads.name: itself and its twin
heads.note: Most weight goes to the token itself; when the same token appeared earlier, that copy gets a share.

heads.name: after the earlier twin
heads.note: When a token appeared before, it looks at the token that came after that earlier copy. Elsewhere it rests on the first token.

heads.name: spread out
heads.note: No sharp peak: the weight is spread over the nearest words, with a little more on the first nouns.

sentences.text: Tag 4127 is a young bamboo shark. We put it back and wrote down Tag 4127.
The fisherman caught a hammerhead and he let it go because it was young.
Fifteen spadenose sharks came in at Sassoon Dock this morning.
